# nemau_pool_member (Resource)

A backend in a pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_pool_member" "web" {
  pool_id       = nemau_pool.web.id
  name          = "web"
  address       = nemau_instance.web.addresses[0]
  protocol_port = 80
  subnet_id     = nemau_subnet.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address of the backend.
- `name` (String) Member name. Changes in place.
- `pool_id` (String) Id of the pool the member belongs to.
- `protocol_port` (Number) Port the backend listens on.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state, `true` by default; `false` takes the member out of service. Changing it replaces the member.
- `subnet_id` (String) Id of the subnet the backend address belongs to.
- `weight` (Number) Weight in the balancing, `1` when not set. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Member id.
- `operating_status` (String) Operating status as reported by the platform.
